description: VN→ZH double question-marking: a wh-question (什么/谁/哪里/…) is already a question and must not carry sentence-final 吗. Learners transfer a yes/no marker onto it. Rule zh-wh-redundant-ma drops the trailing 吗 when an unambiguous wh-word is present and no embedding verb precedes it.
fp_risk_note: Low-medium risk. Drops final 吗 only when an unambiguous wh-word (什么/谁/哪里/哪儿/怎么/为什么/多少) is present and no embedding verb (知道/告诉/问/明白/清楚/记得) precedes it. A plain 吗 question has no wh-word and never matches; an embedded wh-clause ('你知道他是谁吗', 吗 correct) is spared; 几 is excluded to avoid the 'a few' reading.

positive.notes: 什么 wh-question + 吗 → drop 吗.
谁 wh-question + 吗 → drop 吗.
哪里 wh-question + 吗 → drop 吗.

negative.notes: Plain yes/no question, no wh-word — 吗 is required, must abstain.
wh-question with no 吗 — already correct, must abstain.
Embedded wh-clause under 知道 ('do you know who he is') — 吗 is correct on the matrix question, the embedding-verb guard spares it, must abstain.
